34: The fact that  we see, during the Days of Repentance, that is in Elul and the Ten Days of Teshuvah, that all Israel occupy themselves with the recitation of Psalms, is because the recitation of Psalms is effective for repentance, as stated above.  Therefore, it is a very great matter to occupy oneself at all times in the recitation of Psalms, for Psalms [provides] a very, very, great awakening to HaShem, may He be blessed; happy is he who holds fast to it [the practice of reciting Psalms].
